blocks.text:
You will be met at the airport and transferred to your hotel in Santiago. After check-in, begin a half-day city tour with an English-speaking guide.

First, explore the historic centre. You will see Plaza de Armas, Santiago's main square, the Post Office, City Hall and La Moneda government palace.

Then visit Santa Lucía Hill. From the viewpoint, you can see the old buildings of the centre, modern neighbourhoods and high-rises against the Andes.

After the historic centre, continue to eastern Santiago, where broad avenues and glass office towers reveal another side of the city.

If your flight arrives early, you can take an additional trip to the Maipo Valley, one of the wine-growing areas near Santiago, to taste Chilean wines.

In the evening, continue discovering the country through its cuisine. Options include Boragó, Ambrosia, Peumayen and Aquí está Coco, where you can try creative dishes and fresh seafood.
